description: Analysis-intake routes (start.md row 6): reproduce, reinterpret and scan. Variants without a spec here (projection, survey, summary_plot, no_routine) are planned by the judgment graph with the same documents delivered.

specs.title: Analysis intake: a parameter scan over an approved grid

parameters.name: detector_mode
parameters.description: the contract's detector mode; route analysis binds it before CHECK-IN 1

parameters.name: stat_mode
parameters.description: the contract's statistics mode; route analysis binds it before CHECK-IN 1

parameters.name: prescribed_statistic
parameters.description: a statistic the request prescribes is the primary result

steps.title: 01 Environment: the tools and toolchain every planned operation needs
steps.description: Writes {tools: [{name, status: available|missing|unknown, required, required_by}], operations: [every planned operation id]} from the controller's inventory probe.

steps.title: 02 Resource sweep (P6 source ladder)
steps.description: Runs the resource census over the analyses and topic the pinned reading names; every rung keeps its status, and an unreachable source is never read as absent.

steps.title: 02 Route analysis: routine, model, final state, detector and statistic
steps.description: Writes {summary, routine, model, final_state, energy, detector_mode, stat_mode, method, hepdata_record, assumptions: [{id, statement, reason, alternatives, result_sensitive}], decisions, approximations: [{id, reason, bound}], mismatches: [{approximation}], escalate, scan_grid?}.

steps.title: 02 Physics trap sweep (P3)
steps.description: Writes the trap sweep record (trap_sweep.build shape): a verdict for T1..T12; every hit with its consequence and a flag number or an escalation.

steps.title: 02 Figure target and early-verification waypoint (P1)
steps.description: Writes the figure contract (targets with published axis scales and source), the gallery of published candidates, and the waypoint {element, expectation, why_cheap} or, when the reference is withheld, {withheld_waypoints}.

steps.title: 02 Cost record for the plan's highest rung
steps.description: Writes the cost_preflight record (mode, points, status, basis); unknown cost stays unknown.

steps.title: 03-04 Smoke rung: generation through the preserved routine
steps.description: Writes {samples, events, lhe_check, cutflow, qualification: {routine, status}, detector_mode} at smoke statistics.

steps.title: 05 Early-verification waypoint (CHECK-IN 2 evidence)
steps.description: Writes {summary, element, expectation, evidence, figures} for CHECK-IN 2.

steps.title: 06 Published data and likelihood
steps.description: Fetches the record the route analysis names (hepdata_record): tables and, when published, the likelihood.

steps.title: 08 One approved grid point through the full analysis lifecycle
steps.description: One point of the approved grid (parameters.item carries its tag and coordinates); writes {tag, parameters, statistic, limits, detector_mode, statistics (the limit-setting engine's statistics record: situations, chosen methods, validity checks, outcome), uncertainty (its uncertainty statement), limitations (every qualification label)}; the statistics-situation catalogue is a pinned input.

steps.title: 08 Scan assembly with population equality against the approved grid
steps.description: Writes the assembled scan (scan_orchestrator assemble shape): point_population with every approved point and its status, points (completed results), n_planned, n_done, n_missing, missing_tags, statistic, detector_mode.

steps.title: 05 Final figures over the published data
steps.description: Writes {figures: [{id, path, lint}]} for every declared target.

steps.title: Reference comparison with one pinned comparator (P2, P5)
steps.description: Writes {comparator, quantity, basis_manifests: [requested, delivered], unit, lattice, tolerance, residuals, attributions: [{cause, noise_model, above_noise, replicas}]}; when the reference is withheld, {deferred_until_sealed: true} and no published material.

steps.title: 09 Tier A: every number traced to an accepted artifact
steps.description: Writes {verdict: PASS|FAIL, numbers: [{value, artifact}], findings}.

steps.title: 09 Tier B and P8: three written attacks on the result
steps.description: Writes {attacks: [{kind: basis|acceptance|statistics, attack, tested_by, outcome}], findings}.

steps.title: Results deck: claims, numbers and the recipe ledger
steps.description: Writes {headline, numbers: [{value, artifact}], claims, recipe_ledger, limitations}.

specs.description: The analysis route over an approved grid: one governed step per grid point (its own authority check, receipts and failure status), then an assembly whose population equals the approved grid, with every hole explicit. The grid comes from the request or the route analysis and is fixed before CHECK-IN 1. The route adapter is ravel.controller.routes.analysis.

specs.description: Steps 01-09 of the analysis route. The prepare phase (01 environment, 02 inputs) runs before CHECK-IN 1 and supplies its evidence; the smoke rung ends at the waypoint and CHECK-IN 2; the full rung, data acquisition, statistics, figures, verification and the results deck follow; the final review, CHECK-IN 3 and the sink end the run. The route adapter is ravel.controller.routes.analysis.
